title: Lior and the Songbook
author: Rafael Lockridge
blurb: Sable Thornbury, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
